raw_chinese_section:
009 本尊三摩地之益

            我說：只要你「自化本尊」，住於「本尊三摩地」，真實而不動搖，是有大益。因為：瑤池金母是「仙王」。阿彌陀佛是「佛王」。地藏菩薩是「地王」。這「三王」是控制宇宙間萬有一切的主宰者。「三王」不受世間苦惱及他方鬼神的侵襲，所以不用任何庇護。「三王」反而可以庇護自己及守護其他眾生，一切自然安住。又，住本尊三摩地，不受任何煩惱、不被干擾、不受果報、不受宿業。住本尊三摩地，其中有無比的智慧，根本智、分別智、一切種智，均可獲得。益處甚多，述之無窮盡。本尊三摩地包含了：八正道：正見、正思惟、正語、正業、正命、正精進、正念、正定。戒、定、慧全有了。尤其是在本尊三摩地中，逐漸能了知「過去世」、「現在世」、「未來世」，宿命的神通均能知曉。甚至，天眼通、天耳通、他心通、神足通、宿命通、漏盡通均可達成。其實本尊三摩地即是：心識融入本尊。小我融入本尊。意識融入至上本尊。本尊與空性互融。 ● 我們曉得「入三摩地法」，其次第是：專一瑜伽。離戲瑜伽。一味瑜伽。無修瑜伽。但，並不是人人都可以修成。因為人分三品：下品、中品、上品，各各差別。上品——猛力的，增上的。中品——中等強度的。下品——宿業障礙多。例如：疾病侵襲，己身不治，如何「三摩地」為。昏沉侵襲，體弱昏沉，入「四摩地」，睡著了。猶疑不定，信心不足，朝三暮四。放逸嬉戲，喜心遊蕩，浪費時光。慵懶怠性，懶惰性情，無所事事。縱情奔走，喜心蕩漾，無休無日。散亂念頭，如同瀑布，無止妄想。偏見觀念，誤解正法，走入邪門。另有：貢高我慢、暴喜暴怒、心神不定、思緒紊亂。…………這些障礙，唯有勤習「專一」之法，才能破除。修「氣」是很重要的。因為「氣動念頭就動」。用「住氣」及「持氣」，來控制念頭，漸漸的穩定心念，集中在本尊的聖像，這是一個很好的方法。若能定於一。智慧的光，就會出現。
raw_english_section:
009 The Benefits of Yidam Samadhi

 

I say that as soon as you transform into your yidam and dwell in yidam samadhi in a true and unwavering state, there are great benefits.

It is because Golden Mother of Jade Pond is the king of sages, Amitabha Buddha is the king of buddhas, and Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva is the king of the Earth. These “three kings” are the rulers controlling everything in the universe.

They are not affected by worldly suffering or the invasion of ghosts and spirits from other realms, so they need no protection. On the contrary, they can protect themselves and guard other sentient beings, naturally abiding in peace.

Moreover, dwelling in yidam samadhi, you are untouched and unaffected by any affliction; you are not subject to karmic retribution and unbound by past karma.

Dwelling in yidam samadhi, you attain incomparable wisdom, including the fundamental wisdom, the wisdom of discernment, and the all-encompassing wisdom.

The benefits are numerous and inexhaustible.

Yidam samadhi encompasses:

o Noble Eightfold Path—right view, right mindset, right speech, right action, right livelihood, right effort, right thought, and right meditation
o Precepts, meditative stability, and wisdom
o The attainment of the transcendent power of knowing all lives. In yidam samadhi, one gradually knows one’s past, present, and future lives.
o The attainment of [other transcendent powers]—celestial vision, celestial hearing, mind-reading, astral travel, and the exhaustive outflow
In fact, yidam samadhi is:

o the merging of the mind-consciousness with the yidam
o the merging of the small self with the yidam
o the merging of the consciousness with the supreme yidam
o the merging and interpenetration of the yidam with the empty-nature
As we know, the stages of entering samadhi are:

o Yoga of Concentration
o Yoga of Renunciation
o Yoga of One Taste
o Yoga of No-Practice
However, not everyone can achieve it.

People are divided into three categories: lower, middle, and upper grades, each with differences.

o upper grade—intensely powerful and superior
o middle grade—moderately strong
o lower grade—many karmic obstacles
Examples of karmic obstacles and obscurations are:

o Those struck by illness and unable to recover. How can they enter samadhi?
o Those who are weak and lethargic. Overwhelmed by drowsiness, they fall asleep when trying to enter samadhi.
o Those plagued by doubt and lack of faith. They are inconsistent.
o Those lacking discipline. They indulge in pleasures, fun, and frivolity, wasting time.
o Those with ingrained indolence. Lazy and idle, they don’t do much.
o Those who are restless and disconcerted. They roam endlessly.
o Those with scattered and chaotic thoughts like a waterfall, with endless delusions.
o Those with biased views and misconceptions of the right dharma. They deviate from the right path.
Additionally:

o the arrogant ones who feel superior
o those with extreme mood swings
o the mentally unstable
o those with disorderly trains of thought
The only way to overcome these obstacles is through diligent practice of one-pointedness.

Qi (breathing) practice is crucial because thoughts follow the qi, so when qi moves, thoughts move.

An excellent method is to hold the breath (qi) inside you. By letting qi dwell, you can control your thoughts. Gradually, the mind stabilizes and concentrates on the image of the yidam.

If you can stabilize and fixate on one point, the light of wisdom will appear.

analyst_cards.title: Check conditional meaning in the opening
analyst_cards.source: 只要你「自化本尊」，住於「本尊三摩地」，真實而不動搖，是有大益。
analyst_cards.english: as soon as you transform into your yidam and dwell in yidam samadhi in a true and unwavering state
analyst_cards.concern: The Chinese expresses a condition, including genuine and unwavering abiding. “As soon as” may add an immediacy implication. Does the opening preserve the condition without introducing a timing claim?
analyst_cards.possible_direction: Consider “provided that” or “as long as,” subject to the reviewer’s reading of the complete sentence. Preserve the qualification about the state of abiding.
analyst_cards.learning_candidate: Distinguish conditional constructions from temporal triggers. Keep the lesson scoped to comparable constructions; do not globally replace every occurrence of “as soon as.”

analyst_cards.title: Verify the Eightfold Path term mapping
analyst_cards.source: 正思惟 and 正念 within the eight-item sequence.
analyst_cards.english: right mindset and right thought, respectively.
analyst_cards.concern: Check whether these renderings distinguish the two path factors according to the team’s glossary. A TBSN English preface elsewhere uses “Right Intention” and “Right Mindfulness” in the corresponding positions. This is evidence of a terminology discrepancy worth resolving, not proof that the supplied edition must use the newer wording.
analyst_cards.reviewer_action: Confirm the intended mapping and applicable editorial convention, then assess whether any change is needed here. Other terms in the list can be checked in the same review action rather than generating separate noisy alerts.
analyst_cards.learning_candidate: A language- and sense-scoped mapping for the named Eightfold Path list, with edition/style scope if necessary.

analyst_cards.title: Decide how to preserve the samadhi wordplay
analyst_cards.english: they fall asleep when trying to enter samadhi.
analyst_cards.concern: The English conveys the falling-asleep meaning, but the Chinese switches from 三摩地 to 四摩地. In another discourse, the author explicitly uses the latter expression for sleep, supporting a wordplay reading here. Should the English preserve that humor through wording or a brief note, or is conveying the meaning sufficient under the project’s style policy?
analyst_cards.reviewer_action: Make an editorial decision about voice; do not silently normalize the Chinese. No automatic replacement is proposed.
analyst_cards.learning_candidate: An author-specific example of deliberate term alteration in the context of meditation and drowsiness. Future occurrences merit contextual assessment rather than a blanket spelling correction.

analyst_cards.title: Check explanatory additions around qi
analyst_cards.source: 修「氣」是很重要的。 and 用「住氣」及「持氣」，來控制念頭
analyst_cards.english: Qi (breathing) practice is crucial and hold the breath (qi) inside you. By letting qi dwell
analyst_cards.concern: The English explicitly glosses qi as breathing and turns the two expressions into explanatory phrasing. Verify whether the glossary and the author’s intended usage support this level of specificity. The source excerpt alone does not establish the approved English distinction between 住氣 and 持氣.
analyst_cards.reviewer_action: Confirm the terminology and intended equivalence. Avoid generating new practice instructions as a proposed fix.
analyst_cards.learning_candidate: A scoped terminology rule distinguishing the relevant concepts and identifying when explanatory glosses are permitted.

analyst_cards.title: An unfamiliar yoga name is not sufficient evidence of error
analyst_cards.example: 離戲瑜伽 is rendered Yoga of Renunciation. A generic Buddhist terminology check might prefer a different label. However, a TBSN translation of a Vimalakirti discourse describes renunciation in this position within the same progression, alongside concentration, one taste, and no-practice. That provides evidence against automatically treating “Renunciation” as an error.
analyst_cards.desired_behavior: Consult lineage-specific guidance and the project’s glossary before flagging. If the team confirms this wording, retain the scoped decision as evidence for reducing recurring false alarms. Do not infer that it is approved merely because it appears in another publication.

analyst_cards.title: Reorganization is not an omitted list item
analyst_cards.example: The Chinese lists six transcendent powers together. The English discusses knowledge of lives in the preceding bullet, then lists five “[other transcendent powers].” A check limited to the second bullet would wrongly report the missing sixth item.
analyst_cards.desired_behavior: Assess coverage over the aligned surrounding passage. Suppress a count-only omission claim. This does not certify the wording of each power; term accuracy is a separate question.
